data.body: **[P1] Unwrap `ExecutionException` before classifying invocation failures.** `ExceptionHelper.unwrapCompletableFuture` strips only `CompletionException`, so `failedFuture(new ExecutionException(fatal)).join()` from a handler or result-delivery path leaves an `ExecutionException` here. The fatal error is then converted to an ordinary durable failure and does not escape the worker. Recursively unwrap both wrapper types at the shared boundary and add handler and result-delivery tests for this nesting.
